function.name: SetTypes
function.description: Sets the modules to create or change, with their imports and type declarations. The first module is the main one. Call again to change them: each module listed replaces the earlier entry of the same name, modules not listed stay, and remove drops earlier ones.

component.description: The component the module belongs to, exactly as listed: a package name for its library, or package:exe:name for an executable

module.description: Module name, e.g. Billing.Invoice: an existing module to change it, or a new name to create it

extensions.description: LANGUAGE extensions to add, e.g. DerivingStrategies

imports.description: Complete import lines to add, e.g. "import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map"

types.description: Type declarations and instances only: no module header, imports or functions. In an existing module, only new types and complete replacements for changed ones

remove.description: Names of modules recorded earlier to drop from the design
